MCPOAuthManager.Title: OAuth authorizations
MCPOAuthManager.Description: Manage applications connected to MCP through OAuth. Revoked applications need your consent again. Application names are supplied by registrants and do not verify their identity.
MCPOAuthManager.ConfirmRevoke: Revoke authorization for {{name}}? Its access and refresh tokens will stop working immediately.
MCPOAuthManager.ConfirmDisable: Disable {{name}}? This revokes its authorizations for every user and all pending codes. Re-enabling will not restore them.
MCPOAuthManager.ConfirmEnable: Enable {{name}}? Users must authorize again; old tokens will not be restored.

Backup.Title: Backup & restore
Backup.Description: Encrypted backups of the dashboard database and configuration, stored in S3-compatible storage. Monitoring time-series data (TSDB) is not included.

Setup.ScheduleLater: Available after storage and the backup password are set up.
Setup.RestoreDescription: Already have a backup? Restore it from a .nzbak file and its password or recovery key, without setting up storage first.

Storage.Title: S3 storage
Storage.PrefixHint: Dashboards sharing one bucket must use different prefixes, otherwise retention cleanup deletes each other's backups.
Storage.KeepWhenEmpty: Leave empty to keep the saved value
Storage.SecretRequiredMoved: Re-enter the secret after changing the endpoint or bucket.
Storage.EndpointInvalid: The endpoint must start with https://
Storage.PrefixInvalid: The prefix may only contain letters, digits, /, _ and -
Storage.TestFirst: Pass the connection test with these values before saving.

Password.Title: Password and key
Password.SetupHint: Backups are encrypted. The password is needed to restore and is never stored in plain text; scheduled backups run without it.
Password.TooShort: The password must be at least {{min}} characters
Password.ChangeDescription: Keeps the same key pair; only the protection of the private key changes.
Password.ChangedHint: New backups use the new password. Older backups open with the old password, or with the new one on this dashboard.
Password.ResetDescription: Generates a new key pair. Use this only if the password is lost or may have leaked.
Password.ResetWarning: A new key pair will be generated. All previous backups can only be restored with the OLD password or the OLD recovery key. Without either, they are lost for good.
Password.ResetAffected: Backups encrypted with the current key: {{count}}
Password.ResetSubmit: Reset and generate a new key
Password.LoginPasswordHint: Whoever sets the backup password can decrypt every later backup, so confirm with your login password.

RecoveryKey.Title: Save your recovery key
RecoveryKey.Warning: The recovery key can restore every backup of this key pair instead of the password. If you lose the password and do not have this key, backups cannot be restored. Store it offline.
RecoveryKey.Saved: I have stored the recovery key safely

Schedule.Title: Schedule
Schedule.CronHint: 6 fields with seconds, e.g. 0 0 3 * * * (03:00 every day), in the same time zone as scheduled tasks.
Schedule.RetentionHint: Only scheduled backups are cleaned up. Manual backups are never deleted automatically; the last 3 pre-restore backups are kept.
Schedule.RetentionInvalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and {{max}}

List.Title: Backups
List.Encrypted: Files are encrypted; restoring needs the backup password or the recovery key.
List.OldKeyHint: Encrypted with an earlier key: needs the old password or old recovery key
List.ConfirmDeleteManual: Manual and pre-restore backups are never cleaned up automatically. Once deleted they cannot be recovered.

Restore.Title: Restore {{name}}
Restore.Step1Description: Step 1 of 2: check the backup. Nothing is changed yet.
Restore.CredentialRequired: Enter the backup password or the recovery key
Restore.Checking: Downloading and verifying, this can take a few seconds...
Restore.Acknowledge: I understand and want to continue
Restore.Expired: The check has expired. Run it again.
Restore.ApplyWarning: The current database and configuration will be replaced. The dashboard restarts and every session is signed out.
Restore.ConfirmLabel: Type the last {{length}} characters of the backup name
Restore.ReauthNeeded: For your security, sign in again (within the last 10 minutes) before applying a restore.
Restore.PreRestoreBackup: A backup of the current data is taken first (kept as a pre-restore backup).
Restore.NoPreRestoreBackup: No pre-restore backup will be taken (storage or backup password is not set up). The current data cannot be recovered afterwards.

Warning.origin_unverified: The origin of this backup cannot be verified (it was not made by this dashboard). Only continue if you trust the file.
Warning.pre_restore_skipped: A pre-restore backup of the current data cannot be taken. The current data will not be recoverable.
Warning.older_version: The backup was made by an older dashboard version ({{backup}}, this dashboard is {{current}}); the database is upgraded on start.
Warning.version_unknown: The dashboard version of this backup ({{backup}}) or of this dashboard ({{current}}) cannot be compared (for example a development build). Compatibility cannot be checked; continue only if you know both versions match.
Warning.config_not_in_backup: The backup does not contain the configuration; the current configuration is kept.
Warning.tsdb_not_restored: Monitoring time-series data (TSDB) is not restored and stays as it is.
Warning.agents_after_backup_offline: Agents added after this backup will go offline.
Warning.revoked_credentials_revived: API tokens and OAuth grants revoked after this backup become valid again.
Warning.sessions_cleared: All sessions will be signed out.
Warning.version_differs: The backup was made by a different build of the same dashboard version ({{backup}}, this dashboard is {{current}}: same X.Y.Z, different suffix). Builds can differ in database changes; continue only if you know the difference is safe.

Restart.Title: The dashboard is restarting and swapping in the data...
Restart.Description: You will be taken to the sign-in page when it is back.
Restart.Timeout: The dashboard did not come back automatically. Check that it runs under a supervisor (docker restart: always or systemd Restart=always), then sign in.
